name: SRP Project Huckleberry Meta Mesa Data Center Service Record
known_limitations: The SRP project page identifies Meta as the customer, records initial and 230 kV in-service milestones, and says the project is online. It does not disclose Meta's peak load, executed electric-service agreement, tariff charges, operating consumption, spare regional capacity, or service readiness for a semiconductor facility.
jurisdiction: Salt River Project service territory, Mesa, Arizona
automation_notes: Track later project updates, customer load disclosures, service-agreement or tariff records, and operating milestones. Do not transfer this project's service evidence to TSMC or another large-load customer.
notes: Phase 51C named service record. SRP says Project Huckleberry serves Meta's Mesa Data Center, is online, used an initial 69 kV service path for the December 2022 in-service date, and placed the Prickly Pear Substation and 230 kV transmission line in service in May 2024.
